# 2481. Minimum Cuts to Divide a Circle

## Solution 1 (time O(1), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def numberOfCuts(self, n):
        """
        :type n: int
        :rtype: int
        """
        if n == 1:
            return 0
        if n % 2 == 0:
            return n // 2
        return n
```
